integration.description: Pimcore is an open-core enterprise platform that combines product experience management, master data management, and digital asset management into a single centralized system. It offers e-commerce capabilities on top of the Pimcore platform.
integration.overview:
The Pimcore integration allows you to sync your Pimcore data with ShopPrompter®. Not only does it allow you to sync your products, categories, and any form of content like blog posts, but it also allows you to sync your customers and orders.

This allows ShopPrompter® a 360 degree look at your customer and your content.

integration.description: The ShopPrompter® React SDK adds the AI shopping assistant to React applications as a typed `<ShopPrompter>` component, including Next.js with the App Router.
integration.overview:
Render `<ShopPrompter>` anywhere in your React app and configure it with regular props: typed configuration objects, theme and callbacks. It wraps the ShopPrompter® Web Component, so every display mode and theme option of the JavaScript SDK is available.

Use `onCartOperation` and `onProductClick` to connect the assistant to your cart and router, and a ref to open or close the chat from your own UI.

prerequisites.title: A ShopPrompter® API key or token
